An announcement, reposted from the organizers, of the full program for the 2024 Global Audio Summit (GAS), China’s international audio industry conference, held on March 27–28, 2024, at the Zhangjiang Science Hall in Shanghai under the motto “Audio @Future.” The organizers frame the event around two questions: what new demands does an era of rapidly iterating technology and booming user demand place on the audio industry, and how can the whole sector build a shared, thriving ecosystem for the next round of technical and industrial innovation?

The program itself is published as a series of agenda posters. The opening keynote session on March 27 includes the release of an industry white paper for 2023 and the launch of the 2024 edition, the release of reference code for the L2HC audio codec, talks by executives from Huawei, iFlytek, Sannuo Group and Edifier, a regional industry report and a round table on the convergence of audio and AI. Parallel sessions over the two days cover smart in-car audio, smart headphones and wearables, 3D audio, electroacoustic components and chips, hearing aids and assistive listening, smart homes and conferencing, and sound and music technology. The post closes with the lists of sponsors and media partners, a registration code and a short video, and notes that the final program is subject to on-site announcements.

Reposted on Ziyu Acoustics from an announcement by the GAS 2024 organizers.
